notes: The authorising steward is committed as a `personaPublicRef` — the raw personaId is T0 and is never serialised (Identity & Access Spine).

canaries.assertion: The cohort-authorization receipt must contain `Discovered:` and `Assigned to crystal:`; the cohort hash is order-independent (sha256 over the sorted id set) so the identity committed to is the SET, not the click order.

statement: The executable subset is itself an authorized act and must be receipted — with what advanced, what was excluded and why, the cohort hash, and the authorising steward.

occurrences.defect: Partial progress had no durable record, so a batch that proceeded with exclusions left no evidence of what the operator actually authorised.
